question: Ibrahim Lodi was defeated by ______ in the battle of Panipat.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Babur.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first Battle of Panipat, on 20 April 1526, **was fought between the invading forces of **Babur and the Lodi dynasty**. 
 
• It took place in North India and** marked the beginning of the Mughal Empire** and the end of the Delhi Sultanate
 
• In 1526, the **Mughal forces of Babur,** **the Timurid ruler of Kabulistan, defeated the much larger ruling army of Ibrahim Lodi, **Sultan of Delhi

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Muhi al-Din Muhammad, commonly known as Aurangzeb** and by his regnal title** Alamgir,** was the sixth emperor of the Mughal Empire, ruling from July **1658 until his death in 1707**
 
• Nasir-ud-Din Muhammad, better known by his regnal name,** Humayun,** was the **second emperor of the Mughal Empire**, who ruled over territory from **1530 to 1540 and again from 1555 to 1556**
 
• Muhammad Akbar, popularly known as **Akbar the Great**, and also as Akbar I, was the **third Mughal emperor, **who reigned from **1556 to 1605.** Akbar succeeded his father, Humayun, under a regent, Bairam Khan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Mughal Empire **was an Islamic early-modern empire that controlled much of** South Asia between the 16th and 19th centuries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fef9abf750d900a6f8917d73ac9c41f10638c7c9f8232d8cbb64145622e52598.png]
